📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-07-notifications-p95-latency-monitor-noise`
This is occurrence #9 in the last 7 days (36 total since 2026-07-06).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience`
Playbook: Confirm shape via dd_search.py metric p95:trace.aspnet.request{service:notifications,env:prod} over the monitor's own last_10m window plus a wider surrounding window — expect values 0.001-0.2s, nowhere near the 1s threshold; confirm 0 error logs on service:notifications.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded mode (no Slack MCP this session). Monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302056327

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302056327 — "[CRM][P2] notifications P95 latency high" (recovered 08:43:07Z)
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet.request&exp_scope=service%3Anotifications%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=p95&start=1786869000&end=1786870500
  • Kibana: n/a — evidence_source is datadog_apm for this entry, not ES
  • This-window concentration: all real datapoints 0.0006s-0.03s vs 1s threshold (1 rollup-boundary outlier discarded per established rollup-artifact pattern); cleanest non-reproduction in this entry's history

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-eda-consumer-amqp-stopped-publishing`
This is occurrence #11 in the last 7 days (52 total since 2026-06-20).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Integrations`
Playbook: Confirm shape via monitor state; ALWAYS check sibling P1 monitors first (296632224 Event ingest stopped, 296636101 Kafka events stopped) — if both OK, core EDA pipeline is healthy; confirm 0 error logs on service:eda_consumer; escalate only on 3rd+ occurrence with sibling correlation.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded mode (no Slack MCP this session). Monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/296641466 — "[EDA][Consumer][P3] Integration events (AMQP) stopped publishing" (No Data since 10:22:26Z, still open ~58min at last live check)
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aeda_consumer%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=sum&start=1786872600&end=1786879200
  • Kibana: n/a — evidence_source is datadog_apm for this entry, not ES
  • This-window concentration: 0 error logs (service:eda_consumer status:error, 09:30-11:10Z); both sibling P1 monitors (296632224, 296636101) confirmed OK — no pipeline-wide correlation

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
This is occurrence #8 in the last 7 days (130 total since 2026-07-04).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: Confirm the dip via dd_search.py metric sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:<name>,env:prod}.as_rate() over a multi-hour window — expect a genuine but brief dip below the monitor's floor following a burst, not a data gap. Confirm 0 error logs on service:<name>. Check the 4 sibling team:crm AMQP-consumer monitors — if all OK, this is the benign quiet-period pattern. Escalate only if still open after ~1h or a sibling co-fires.
Open Jira: n/a

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded mode (no Slack MCP this session). Monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/302057011 — "[CRM] runtime-core-subscriber throughput dropped (possible stall)" (Alert since 13:05:31Z)
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.amqp.command.hits&exp_scope=service%3Aruntime-core-subscriber%2Cenv%3Aprod&exp_agg=avg&start=1786883400&end=1786885800
  • Kibana: n/a — evidence_source is datadog_apm for this entry, not ES
  • This-window concentration: genuine burst 12:39-12:47Z (~102-126 msg/s) then sub-2msg/s baseline from 12:48Z onward; 0 error logs 12:35:31-13:08:46Z; all 4 sibling AMQP-consumer monitors OK, no co-firing
